API tokens

Manage your prep
from anywhere.

Generate a personal access token to call prep's REST API or wire prep up as an MCP server to your AI coding assistant. Tokens are long-lived and per-account; revoke any one without touching the others.

How to use

Set the token as a Bearer credential on the Authorization header: 

curl -H "Authorization: Bearer prep_pat_..." \
  https://prepcards.app/api/v1/decks

Full endpoint reference + try-it-now console live at /docs (Swagger UI) or /redoc. Raw schema at /openapi.json.

Setting prep up as an MCP server in Claude or other AI clients: walk-through at /settings/agent.

Install prep on your home screen.

Faster open, offline-tolerant, push-notified when a stack of cards comes due.

  1. Tap the Share button in the Safari toolbar.
  2. Scroll and pick Add to Home Screen.
  3. Tap Add.

Tap Install prep below and your browser will offer to add it to your home screen.

On iPhone and iPad, only the system Safari browser can install web apps. Open this page in Safari and tap the Install prep pill at the bottom to continue.

Your browser doesn't support installing this as an app. Try Chrome, Edge, or Safari.
